all_original_tracked_files.method: For each git ls-tree blob at base, hash current bytes as Git blob SHA-1 and compare base object ID; also SHA-256 selected inventories below.

contact_reference_component.evidence_kind: source identity and explicit installation rule inspection

limitations: One synthetic nominal dry fixture at one rate/block/note/registration only; no universal audio, all-state or physical-instrument proof.
Source identity preserves existing code and original evidence; it does not grant fresh native VST3, physical hardware, platform or installation qualification.
No configure, build, broad test suite or install was executed by A30. Root owns coherent CTest and later publication.
The baseline qualification field baseline_pcm_sha256 is tested against both whole WAV and decoded PCM below; preserve the original field unchanged.
overlay_scope_note: Original tracked-file difference counts describe the recorded audit time. Later shared documentation reconciliation may change the overlay count while production preservation stays bound to the listed source hashes.

root_coherent_gate_review.attribution: Root executed the coherent build/CTest. A30 checked the receipt, compressed source inventory and log; did not rerun the suite.
